name: vision_detector_bad
title: The same YOLO-shaped detector with ten planted defects
origin: domain-vision round 1: the dirty twin of vision_detector

expected.defect: the three detection heads are held in a plain list comprehension instead of an nn.ModuleList
expected.why: model.parameters() never sees them, so the optimiser never updates the heads and .to(device) leaves them on the CPU

expected.defect: the training step never calls optimizer.zero_grad()
expected.why: every update applies the accumulated gradient of the whole epoch

expected.defect: the classification head returns raw logits and the loss is nn.BCELoss, which expects probabilities in [0, 1] - the sigmoid is missing
expected.why: BCELoss takes the log of a negative number for every negative logit, so the loss is NaN from the first batch

expected.defect: the training loader neither shuffles nor carries a sampler
expected.why: annotation files are grouped by source video, so each batch is one scene

expected.defect: the loaders are constructed at import time with four workers and the module has no __main__ guard
expected.why: on spawn platforms every worker re-imports this module and builds three more loaders, recursively

expected.defect: the validation loader is built at import time with four workers
the test loader is built at import time with four workers
the gradient norm is clipped after the update has already been applied
expected.why: the clip has no effect on this step and silently clips the gradients the next step will not use
the backbone's BatchNorm2d layers keep updating their running statistics from validation batches, so the reported mAP depends on the order the validation set was read in

expected.defect: the mAP loop is not wrapped in torch.no_grad()
expected.why: the autograd graph of every detection is built and dropped
per-image detections come back in a different order every run

forbidden.why: DetectionLoss.forward collects the per-image terms in `parts` and returns torch.stack(parts).sum() - the documented 'a list of tensors later torch.stacked and backwarded' guard; the graph must stay alive until train.py:71
same statement group: the regression term is appended to the same stacked list
optimizer.step() is called in every batch - the missing call in this twin is zero_grad, not step
no backward() call is inside a no_grad region
there is no softmax-before-CrossEntropyLoss pairing here; the planted loss defect is the BCE one
to_device() still moves the images and every target field
seed_everything() still seeds random, numpy and torch
every nn.Module subclass still calls super().__init__()

gaps.what: postprocess() runs batched_nms over every anchor and applies the score threshold afterwards, so suppression is decided by background boxes and the max_detections cut discards real ones - no rule covers detection post-processing order

CocoStyleDetection._augment ignores self.train, so the random horizontal flip runs on the validation and test images - MLV114 only follows transforms handed to a known dataset class through transform=, not augmentation written inside __getitem__
